14. 24-51840  Closed Session- Executive Director’s Performance Evaluation (Pursuant to

  President Frost Hollins announced that the Commission will move this item after
  Public Comment.

  President Frost Hollins announced that the Commission will go into closed session
  at 10:30 a.m.The Commission returned from closed session at 11:00 a.m.

  President Frost reported that there will be two follow-up closed sessions next to
  subsequent regular meetings. One will be a meeting for Commissioners to
  assemble an evaluation for Christina Pizarro Winting, and there will be a closed
  session with Christina Pizarro Winting to provide the final review.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Julia Smay addressed the Commission regarding her departure from the Civil Service department.

Armida Leon addressed the Commission regarding their eligible list comments.

Caprice McDonald addressed the Commission regarding the budget presentation and recruitment
events.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

The Commission shared their experience during the Martin Luther King, Jr. Parade and thanked the
staff who attended on behalf of the Civil Service department.

Commissioner Osuna extended an apology for an earlier disagreement with the City Hall Security
staff.

ADJOURNMENT

At 10:30 a.m., there being no objection, President Frost Hollins declared the meeting adjourned.
